001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.hullmods;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004import java.util.Map;
005
006import java.awt.Color;
007
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.GameState;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.MutableShipStatsAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI.HullSize;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.fleet.FleetMemberAPI;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.HullMods;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Stats;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Strings;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
018import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
019
020public class RecoveryShuttles extends BaseLogisticsHullMod {
021
022        public static float MIN_CR = 0.1f;
023        public static float MAX_RECOVERED = 0.8f;
024        
025        public static float SMOD_MULT = 1.5f;
026        
027        
028        private static Map mag = new HashMap();
029        static {
030                mag.put(HullSize.FRIGATE, 10f);
031                mag.put(HullSize.DESTROYER, 20f);
032                mag.put(HullSize.CRUISER, 40f);
033                mag.put(HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP, 80f);
034        }
035        
036        public void applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation(HullSize hullSize, MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id) {
037                boolean sMod = isSMod(stats);
038                float mult = 1f;
039                if (sMod) mult = SMOD_MULT;
040                stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.FIGHTER_PILOTS_RECOVERED_MOD).modifyFlat(id, (Float) mag.get(hullSize) * mult);
041        }
042        
043        public String getDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize) {
044                if (index == 0) return "" + ((Float) mag.get(HullSize.FRIGATE)).intValue();
045                if (index == 1) return "" + ((Float) mag.get(HullSize.DESTROYER)).intValue();
046                if (index == 2) return "" + ((Float) mag.get(HullSize.CRUISER)).intValue();
047                if (index == 3) return "" + ((Float) mag.get(HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP)).intValue();
048                
049                return null;
050        }
051        
052        public String getSModDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize) {
053                if (index == 0) return Misc.getRoundedValueMaxOneAfterDecimal(SMOD_MULT) + Strings.X;
054                return null;
055        }
056        
057        public boolean isApplicableToShip(ShipAPI ship) {
058                if (Misc.isAutomated(ship.getVariant())) return false;
059                return super.isApplicableToShip(ship); 
060        }
061        
062        public String getUnapplicableReason(ShipAPI ship) {
063                if (Misc.isAutomated(ship.getVariant())) {
064                        return "Can not be installed on automated ships";
065                }
066                return super.getUnapplicableReason(ship);
067        }
068        
069        @Override
070        public boolean shouldAddDescriptionToTooltip(HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship, boolean isForModSpec) {
071                return true;
072        }
073
074        @Override
075        public void addPostDescriptionSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship, float width, boolean isForModSpec) {
076                float pad = 3f;
077                float opad = 10f;
078                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
079                Color bad = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
080                
081                if (isForModSpec || ship == null) return;
082                if (Global.getSettings().getCurrentState() == GameState.TITLE) return;
083                
084                float fleetMod = getFighterPilotsRecoveredForPlayerShips();
085                float cr = ship.getCurrentCR();
086                for (FleetMemberAPI member : Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
087                        if (member.getId().equals(ship.getFleetMemberId())) {
088                                cr = member.getRepairTracker().getCR();
089                                if (!member.getVariant().hasHullMod(HullMods.RECOVERY_SHUTTLES) &&
090                                                ship.getVariant().hasHullMod(HullMods.RECOVERY_SHUTTLES)) {
091                                        fleetMod += ship.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.FIGHTER_PILOTS_RECOVERED_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
092                                }
093                                break;
094                        }
095                }
096                
097                if (cr < MIN_CR) {
098                        tooltip.addPara("This ship's combat readiness is below %s " +
099                                "and the recovery shuttles on it can not be utilized.", opad);
100                }
101                
102                tooltip.addPara("The maximum number of fighter pilots that can "
103                                + "be recovered by all of the shuttles in your fleet is %s.", opad, h,
104                                "" + (int)Math.round(fleetMod) + "");
105                
106        }
107        
108        public static int getFighterPilotsRecoveredForPlayerShips() {
109                return getFighterPilotsRecoveredForPlayerShips(null);
110        }
111        
112        public static int getFighterPilotsRecoveredForPlayerShips(FleetMemberAPI exclude) {
113                float total = 0f;
114                for (FleetMemberAPI member : Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
115                        if (member.isMothballed()) continue;
116                        if (member.getRepairTracker().getCR() < RecoveryShuttles.MIN_CR) continue;
117                        if (member == exclude) continue;
118                        float v = member.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.FIGHTER_PILOTS_RECOVERED_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
119                        if (v <= 0) continue;
120                        total += v;
121                }
122                return Math.round(total);
123        }
124}
